title: Game, set, sunset
text: Our own tennis court and a pool with a sun terrace, free for every guest of the hotel and the villa.
video_label: A serve on the hotel court at sunset
court_text: Our own court in the middle of the estate. Play before the heat or after it: the lights come on when the sun goes down.
pool_text: Sunbeds by day, daybeds for the slow hours, lights for a late swim.

pool_points.title: Sunbeds and parasols
pool_points.text: Along the limestone wall, for the long middle of the day.

pool_points.title: Daybeds with white curtains
pool_points.text: Shade, a book and a slow afternoon above the court.

pool_points.title: Lit after dark
pool_points.text: Underwater lights for a late swim. [Open from … to …] · [pool towels]

plan_text: Rooms on terraces stepping down the hill, the court in the middle, the pool above it and olive groves all around. Tap a place on the photo to see it.

places.name: Pool
places.text: The pool and its limestone sun terrace, with sunbeds and parasols. Lit after dark for a late swim.

places.name: Tennis court
places.text: Our own court, free for guests and lit in the evening.

places.name: Daybeds
places.text: Four daybeds with white curtains above the court.

places.name: Barbecue
places.text: The barbecue corner right next to the court, for long evenings outside.

places.name: Lawns
places.text: Lawns between the terraces, with places to sit: a quiet corner in the shade with a book.

places.name: Olive grove
places.text: Olive groves around the hotel, with paths to walk at golden hour.

end_title: Pack a swimsuit, leave the racket
end_text: The court and the pool are free for every guest, in the rooms and at the villa. Rackets and balls are waiting at the court.
